i'm rather torn on downwell. aesthetically & sonically it's highly pleasing, and i enjoyed it enough to 100%, although i must say there are only a handful of games which consistently annoy me to this degree.

the hard mode in this game simply feels plainly unfair at times - precise movement is required in order to squeeze past the hordes of enemies you're met with constantly, whilst the characters just moves in a kind of slippery manner, and i swear these hitboxes are sketchy sometimes (maybe i'm just coping though). regardless, downwell is hard - hence, you'll be dying a lot, so noteworthy variation between runs if effectively a necessity here, and i think this game delivers?

almost all the guns are fun to use (noppy can go light itself on fire though) & the perks are pretty well-made, even if the balance is lacking. the replayability here comes more from the addicting, fast-paced gameplay than randomness, although it does still play a part. this game almost moves a bit too quickly for my liking though - i love games that are unrelenting speed-wise, à la post void or ultrakill, but my god downwell should take a chill pill sometimes. if i'm in the mood for it i can have a delightful experience however.

anyway i've neglected mentioning my main problem with this game up to this point - the combo system. this game gives literally 0 explanation as to how it works so i'll be following in this practice out of spite - the concept of making an arcade-style game which disincentivises the player from maximising their combo is just bizarre to me. you're intentionally sabotaging yourself if you don't cut the streak at 15/25, and i just flat-out cannot understand this game design decision. i guess one could argue it adds a more tactical, strategical aspect to the work, but i just don't understand why resources wouldn't keep rising after 25.

game is fun all-in-all. requires some decent mechanics to really enjoy & a tolerance to annoyance, but if the artstyle of this one call to you & neither of those are disqualifying characteristics, go for it. i believe i was overly ♥♥♥♥♥♥ this review, i did enjoy my time spent here for what it's worth. side note but this game not detailing the palette system in the trailer at all is weird it's one of the most refreshing, charming things here; wetland supremacy.

Assez rapidement on se retrouve à rebondir d'ennemi en ennemi, tout en tirant intelligemment pour avoir la trajectoire parfaite sans vider son chargeur, on récupère tous les bonus, on achète tout dans le magasin et on se sent surpuissant
Jusqu'à ce qu'on meurt à cause d'une tortue mal placée et là on se sent bien bête

Ca sera pas un long jeu qui va vous transporter dans une histoire de plusieurs dizaines d'heure, mais il vous mettra face à la fameuse "juste une dernière" qui ne se finit jamais
